# `dry auth`

Authenticate with Dry Cloud

## Help

```text
Authenticate with Dry Cloud

Usage: dry auth [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  login   Sign in with Dry Cloud's device authorization flow
  status  Show the current account and monthly usage
  logout  Remove the locally stored Dry Cloud token
  help    Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --cloud-url <CLOUD_URL>  Dry Cloud origin. `DRY_CLOUD_URL` takes precedence over the hosted default
  -h, --help                   Print help
```
